title: config/ini parses 220 documents exactly as the former native codec
purpose: Verify the public library contract with exact, independently derived values.

provenance.origin: authored for #13: inputs generated at random, expected values recorded from the native runtime/ini parser of release/0.4.1 (4a246919) before it was removed
provenance.expected_basis: The Okkama codec replaced the native one with identical behaviour: each document gives the same sections and entries, or the same line, column and message of the first failure. 10 cases per failure class, 30 valid documents.
